The word for it

HR teams call this attrition.

Attrition is the number of people who leave a company over a set period, such as a month or a year. "Turnover" usually means the same thing.

  • Quit
  • Retire
  • Let go

Why it happens

People leave for many reasons. High attrition often points to problems inside the company.

  • Poor management
  • Few chances to grow
  • Hard working conditions

Why the business feels it

When people leave too often, the whole site pays. Tap each cost.

  • New hires take time to train, so orders wait.

  • Hiring and training for the same job again and again adds up fast.

  • Fewer people means more pressure on the ones who stay.

  • People leave with skills nobody else has learned yet.

  • A reputation for high turnover puts off new applicants.
